info.prompt: Side profile of a paladin's armored hand releasing a glowing gold die onto a surface of fractured crystal, the impact sending ripples through the neon-cyan liquid beneath that illuminates submerged hacker-code fragments, the dice class badge burning white-hot as it consumes its final charge pip, the resulting shockwave distorting the camera lens and triggering a cinematic sweep across the skeletal gold interface where rogue and bard abilities lie dormant in amber-lit reserve slots.
